Volt Pilot

AI-Powered Automation for PSCAD Simulation Workflows

AI-powered automation for PSCAD simulation workflows.

Volt Pilot is an independent software platform designed to help engineers automate repetitive tasks surrounding PSCAD simulations. It connects to a user's PSCAD simulation output workflow to monitor simulation activity, organize results, generate reports, and deliver notifications when simulations are complete.

With AI-assisted diagnostics, Volt Pilot can analyze PSCAD simulation logs, errors, warnings, and available output information to help identify potential problems, investigate possible causes, and suggest troubleshooting approaches.

Built for PSCAD Workflows
◆PSCAD Simulation Monitoring — Monitor designated PSCAD output directories and detect simulation activity.
◆Automated PSCAD Reports — Transform simulation output and results into organized, professional reports.
◆AI Simulation Diagnostics — Analyze PSCAD errors, warnings, and logs to help identify potential issues.
◆Simulation Completion Alerts — Receive an SMS notification when your simulation workflow or report is ready.
◆Output Organization — Keep simulation reports and generated files organized in one place.
◆AI-Assisted Troubleshooting — Get potential causes and recommended areas to investigate when a simulation encounters problems.
◆Centralized Dashboard — Manage your simulation workflow, reports, notifications, and diagnostics from a single application.

PSCAD simulations can take significant time to complete, while reviewing outputs and preparing documentation can add even more manual work. Volt Pilot is designed to automate these repetitive steps so engineers can spend more time analyzing results and less time waiting, monitoring, and formatting.

◆ Process Monitoring
◆ Automated Reporting
◆ Diagnostic Analysis
◆ Alert Notifications
◆ Unified Dashboard
◆ Custom Integrations

Volt Pilot's intelligent system analyzes operational logs, identifies anomalies, and surfaces insights that enable faster problem resolution. The platform integrates seamlessly with your existing infrastructure, providing a centralized command center for workflow management and optimization.

Volt Pilot
Your intelligent automation layer for PSCAD simulation workflows.
